forbidden_patterns.name: implementation heading
forbidden_patterns.help: Describe the customer workflow or move the material to an explicitly classified developer page.

forbidden_patterns.name: raw API endpoint
forbidden_patterns.help: Customer pages should describe the action in the product, not an internal endpoint.

forbidden_patterns.name: internal source or test path
forbidden_patterns.help: Remove repository paths from customer documentation.

forbidden_patterns.name: source filename
forbidden_patterns.help: Move source-level references to a developer page.

forbidden_patterns.name: environment assignment
forbidden_patterns.help: Environment and deployment configuration is not customer setup guidance.

forbidden_patterns.name: internal implementation identifier
forbidden_patterns.help: Replace internal identifiers with customer-visible behavior.

forbidden_patterns.name: internal release language
forbidden_patterns.pattern: (?i)\b(?:acceptance criteria|developer and deployment setup|release gate|CI check|test fixture|capture spec)\b
forbidden_patterns.help: Customer documentation should explain the supported workflow, not internal development or release evidence.

forbidden_patterns.name: cloud implementation vendor
forbidden_patterns.help: Customer pages should describe the supported product workflow, not its hosting or model-routing implementation.

forbidden_patterns.name: unsupported absolute claim
forbidden_patterns.help: Use bounded, verifiable customer language and identify the user's compliance responsibility.

forbidden_patterns.name: fixed plan entitlement
forbidden_patterns.help: Plan availability changes over time; link to current pricing or tell the customer to check the subscription shown in the product.

forbidden_patterns.name: fixed provider price snapshot
forbidden_patterns.help: Provider prices and fees are time-sensitive; direct customers to current provider or subscription information.

forbidden_patterns.name: fixed monthly price snapshot
forbidden_patterns.help: Monthly prices become stale; link customers to current pricing instead.

forbidden_patterns.name: unsupported BAA roadmap claim
forbidden_patterns.help: Do not promise a vendor agreement or roadmap item that the current customer workflow cannot prove.

forbidden_patterns.name: unsupported revenue claim
forbidden_patterns.pattern: (?i)\b(?:typically recovers?|annual revenue restoration|5-figure annual revenue|highest-impact billing tools?)\b
forbidden_patterns.help: Remove unsubstantiated earnings or recovery claims and describe the verified customer workflow instead.

forbidden_patterns.name: raw provider permission scope
forbidden_patterns.help: Customer setup should follow the provider permission screen; raw authorization scopes belong in developer documentation.
